name: LAN-Orangutan
description: LAN Orangutan is a lightweight network scanner with persistent device labeling, multi-network support, and Tailscale integration. Built by 291 Group.
readme_summary: LAN Orangutan is a self-hosted network discovery tool that allows users to scan their local networks, identify devices, and manage them with persistent labeling. It offers both a web dashboard and a CLI interface, with integrated support for Tailscale.
key_features: Label, group, and add notes to devices
primary_use_case: Network discovery and device management for homelab environments.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, stylized orangutan wearing a hard hat and holding a magnifying glass, standing in a bustling digital cityscape representing a home network. The orangutan is pointing its magnifying glass at various glowing icons of devices (laptops, smart TVs, servers) that are neatly arranged and labeled with small, clear tags. Subtle data streams flow between the devices and a central hub, indicating network activity. In the background, a small, stylized Tailscale logo is visible, connecting different parts of the network. The overall mood is helpful and organized, with a clean, modern illustration style, perhaps 3D isometric, emphasizing clarity and ease of use.

name: univer-workspace
description: An open-source Office workspace where people and AI agents create, collaborate, and review together.
readme_summary: Univer Workspace is an open-source, self-hostable office suite that integrates documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and databases into a unified environment. It facilitates collaboration between human users and AI agents for content creation, review, and automation, offering multiple entry points like a browser, agent, and CLI.
key_features: Unified office suite (Sheets, Docs, Slides, Bases, Boards)
Integration with AI agents for content generation and review
Multiple entry points: Workspace Browser, Workspace Agent, Workspace CLI
primary_use_case: To provide a collaborative, AI-enhanced office workspace for creating, managing, and reviewing documents and data, suitable for both individual and team use, with options for automation.
cover_image_prompt: A bustling, futuristic workshop where human artisans and intelligent robots collaborate seamlessly. In the center, a large, interactive workbench displays a dynamic blend of documents, spreadsheets, and presentation slides, all interconnected by glowing data streams. One artisan is sketching on a tablet, while a robot arm precisely manipulates a 3D model derived from spreadsheet data. Small screens around the workshop show code snippets and AI-generated insights. The overall mood is one of productive synergy and innovation, with subtle Univer Workspace branding integrated into the workshop's signage. The style should be a vibrant, 3D isometric illustration with a clean, modern aesthetic and bright, inviting lighting.

name: nocodb
readme_summary: NocoDB is a free, self-hostable alternative to Airtable, enabling users to build databases online with ease. It provides a no-code platform that automatically generates REST APIs, allowing for seamless data management and integration.
primary_use_case: To provide a user-friendly, no-code interface for creating and managing databases, with automatic API generation for easy integration into other applications.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled artisan in a bustling workshop, effortlessly transforming raw blocks of data (represented as rough stone) into polished, interconnected structures (like intricate wooden furniture or organized shelves). The artisan uses a magical blueprint that displays a clean, user-friendly interface, guiding the transformation. Small, glowing digital particles representing API connections flow from the finished structures to other parts of the workshop. The NocoDB logo is subtly etched onto the artisan's tools. The scene is brightly lit with a clean, organized aesthetic, rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with vibrant colors and clear visual elements.

name: awesome-mac
description:  This project is dedicated to collecting high-quality macOS software and organizing them systematically by different categories for easy search and use.
readme_summary: This repository is a curated list of high-quality macOS software, organized by category to facilitate easy discovery and use. It aims to be a comprehensive resource for Mac users looking for reliable applications.
key_features: Curated list of high-quality macOS software
primary_use_case: Discovering and finding high-quality software for macOS.
cover_image_prompt: A vibrant, organized library shelves filled with glowing icons representing various macOS applications. A friendly librarian, embodying the 'awesome-mac' logo, is handing a user a perfectly chosen app icon. The background subtly features a stylized Mac computer screen displaying a clean, categorized interface. The overall mood is helpful and efficient, with a clean, modern aesthetic. The image should be a 3D isometric illustration with bright, inviting colors and clear, crisp details, emphasizing the ease of finding the right tool.
